sentences.text:
Petitioner :- Vijay Shankar
Respondent :- State Of Uttar Pradesh And 4 Others

Counsel for Petitioner :- Shailesh Pandey
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Vikram D. Chauhan,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Standing Counsel for the State.

2.  The writ petition is filed with the following prayer:
"I. Issue a writ order or direction in the nature of mandamus directing to the direct the Respondent No.3 to reinstate to the petitioner in service and paid his salary month to month.
II. Issue a writ order or direction in the nature of mandamus directing to the Respondent No.3 to decide the representation of the petitioner moved on 18.02.2025 within a stipulated period."

3. It is submitted by learned counsel for petitioner that petitioner was working as Class IV employee Vijay Shankar vs State Of Uttar Pradesh And 4 Others on 10 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/24565116/
1 and a criminal case was lodged against petitioner being Case Crime No.142 of 2018, under Sections 409, 419, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120B/34 IPC and Section 13(2) Prevention of Corruption Act, P.S.
Kachhwa, District Mirzapur, in which, he was arrested on 31.1.2023, and thereafter, on 3.2.2023 petitioner was placed under suspension on account of arrest.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for petitioner submits that now the petitioner has been enlarged on bail and the matter is required to be re-considered by the respondent no.4-Committee of Managment, Shri Gandhi Vidyalaya Inter College,
Kachhwa,Mirzapur, in view of the fact that petitioner has been released on bail.

4. Learned Standing Counsel submits that matter is required to be looked into by respondent no.4.
5.

In view of above, the writ petition is disposed of with liberty to the petitioner to make a representation before the respondent no.4-Committee of Managment, Shri Gandhi Vidyalaya Inter College, Kachhwa,Mirzapur, through it's Manager within a period of two weeks from today along with certified copy of the order.
In the event any such representation is filed, respondent no.4 shall pass reasoned and speaking order within one month.
